intro: If Hyderabad has been on your list, consider this your sign. Biryani, pearls and Nizami palaces, all within reach of a short holiday.

sections.heading: Why visit Hyderabad
paragraphs: Hyderabad (Telangana) is known for its city, food and heritage experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to February.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport has flights from across India.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Go to Golconda in the late afternoon and stay for the views at sunset.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Hyderabad?

faq.a: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport has flights from across India.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Hyderabad?
faq.a: Popular choices: Banjara Hills for upscale stays; Old City for heritage; HITEC City for business.
